prompt: How many versions of the .NET platform have been released that have a support lifetime of more than 12 months?
answer:
**12 versions** of the .NET platform have had a support lifetime of more than 12 months.

The only released version in the listed .NET/Core history with support lasting **12 months or less** was **.NET Core 3.0**, supported from September 23, 2019, until March 3, 2020. This count excludes the .NET 11 release candidate, which was not yet a final release as of October 27, 2026.
